description: This source file implements the WebAudioPlayerService class, which manages WebAudioPlayer instances, including creation, destruction, and control operations such as play, pause, setEos, buffer management, device info retrieval, and volume control within the Rialto server service namespace.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: A service class managing WebAudioPlayer instances, providing thread-safe creation, destruction, and control operations.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer instance with specified parameters if conditions permit.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance associated with the given handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback on the WebAudioPlayer identified by handle.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the WebAudioPlayer identified by handle.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets End Of Stream on the WebAudioPlayer identified by handle.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffer to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the specified WebAudioPlayer.
